notes:
If your Windows account name has characters outside plain English, installing the helper used to finish without ever actually working: everything looked fine, but the game quietly loaded nothing and the panel just sat there connecting. That is fixed. The install now finds a plain spelling of its folders that the game loader can always read, and if your machine cannot provide one at all, the install says so up front instead of leaving things half done.

If you were already affected, just update: a broken configuration from before is repaired automatically at the next start.

Update as usual, the app reinstalls itself cleanly.
